title: Daily Trending Projects
summary: 今天最明显的趋势是 Agent 基础设施继续从单纯编排转向更低成本、更可审计、更持久的运行层：OpenDots 把持久 Agent 与独立计算机、人工审批和多端交互组合起来，Moli 从浏览器内核层为 Agent 降低渲染成本，e2e 把自然语言测试转成可回放的确定性步骤；与此同时，draw.io MCP、LDraw Nova、Showoff 等项目说明 Agent-native 创作工具正在从文本/代码扩展到架构图、3D 模型和发布视频。安全侧 Rowan 针对 AI/MCP 应用做静态扫描，PixelLeak 事件也进一步强化了运行时权限和产物审计的重要性。

items.title: CopilotKit/OpenDots
items.summary: 开源的持久 AI coworker 模板：每个 Agent 可以拥有独立计算机、浏览器配置、文件与 shell，并在 Web、语音和 Slack 之间持续工作。
items.why_it_matters: 它把 Agent 的长期状态、独立执行环境、人工审批、页面工作区和多端交互放进同一个可自托管模板，代表个人/团队 Agent 从一次性会话向长期数字同事演进。
items.evidence: GitHub.Locker reported OpenDots as the fastest-growing autonomous-agent project on Oct 2 at about +1K stars/day; the official repository describes per-Agent computers, persistent browser/files, review-before-save, calls and Slack integration.

extra.trend_signal: Fastest-growing autonomous-agent project in GitHub.Locker's Oct 2 snapshot; very new persistent-agent template.

items.title: lexmount/moli
items.summary: Rust 编写的面向 AI Agent 的独立 headless browser 内核，不是 Chromium wrapper；默认跳过不必要的 layout/paint，只在需要截图或坐标操作时按需渲染。
items.why_it_matters: 浏览器 Agent 的大量任务只需要 DOM、网络和结构化文本。Moli 把昂贵的视觉渲染变成按需能力，有机会显著降低大规模 crawling、browser-use 和 RL 环境的资源成本。
items.evidence: GitHub.Locker listed moli at about +1.5K stars/day on Oct 2; the official repo documents a standalone Rust browser kernel with V8, Stylo, on-demand layout and CDP/WebDriver support.

extra.trend_signal: One of the fastest-growing AI-agent repositories in the Oct 2 snapshot.

items.title: tester-army/e2e
items.summary: 新一代 Web/移动端 E2E 测试框架：允许 Agent 用自然语言执行操作，但把已验证动作记录下来，后续运行优先确定性回放，只有应用变化时再调用模型。
items.why_it_matters: 它把 Agent 的灵活探索和传统测试的可重复性结合起来，避免每次 CI 都重新付模型成本，也降低纯视觉/自然语言测试的不稳定性。
items.evidence: GitHub.Locker reported roughly +972 stars/day on Oct 2. The official repo supports Web plus iOS/Android and records Agent actions for replay without model calls until the app changes.

extra.trend_signal: Fast breakout in the AI-agent tooling tracker; active pre-1.0 development.

items.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman
items.summary: 面向 Coding Agent 的 token 压缩 Skill/代理层，把冗长自然语言改写成极简表达，同时声称保持代码和错误文本逐字节不变。
items.why_it_matters: Agent 成本优化正在从换模型转向 context/output pipeline。Caveman 的爆发说明开发者开始把 token 视为可由中间件主动治理的系统资源。
items.evidence: Oct 3 trend coverage placed Caveman near the top of GitHub daily trending. The maintainer reports about 65% fewer output tokens; that savings figure is author-reported and should be treated as such.

extra.trend_signal: Near the top of Oct 3 GitHub daily trending; unusually strong discussion around token-efficiency middleware.

items.title: jgraph/drawio-mcp
items.summary: draw.io 官方 MCP/Agent 集成，可让模型创建可交互、可继续编辑的原生 draw.io 图，并提供 10,000+ 可搜索图形。
items.why_it_matters: Agent 生成架构图正在从 Mermaid 这种只读式文本输出走向真正可编辑的设计资产；官方 MCP、Skill 和导出链路让图表进入工程工作流而不是停留在聊天结果。
items.evidence: The official draw.io MCP registry entry reports 5,555 and documents MCP App, MCP Tool Server and assistant plugins for Claude Code, Codex CLI and GitHub Copilot.

extra.trend_signal: Featured in Oct 3 agent-tooling digests as draw.io's official MCP server; strong fit for editable Agent-generated diagrams.

items.title: Hedgerow-dev/rowan
items.summary: 面向 AI/ML/MCP 项目的开源 SAST 扫描器，检查注入、SSRF、秘密泄露、不安全反序列化、危险 Agent tools 和模型加载等问题。
items.why_it_matters: AI 应用的攻击面已经超出传统 Web 代码。Rowan 尝试把模型文件、MCP/Agent 工具和普通源码放进统一静态审计范围，而且扫描本身不执行目标代码、不调用 LLM。
items.evidence: Show HN on Oct 3 introduced Rowan as an open-source SAST scanner for AI apps. Coverage reports 590 rules across 48 YAML files and notes the project is alpha.

extra.trend_signal: Fresh Show HN launch on Oct 3 focused specifically on AI/MCP static security analysis.

items.title: Human-Agent-Society/reef
items.summary: 持续自我改进 Agent 的开源基础设施：记录交互与反馈，生成模型权重或 harness/skills 更新，评估候选并按版本发布。
items.why_it_matters: 它把 self-improving agent 从概念拆成 Serve→Observe→Grow→Commit 的可运营闭环，并且既能演化模型权重，也能演化 prompts、rules、skills 和 harness。
items.evidence: Official GitHub snapshot on Oct 3 showed 7,481 stars and active updates. Reef exposes OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible serving and versioned learning workflows for model weights or agent harnesses.

extra.trend_signal: Active Oct 3 updates and growing attention around continual self-improving agents.

items.title: anteloc/ldraw-nova
items.summary: 让 Agent 从文字想法生成可编辑 LEGO/LDraw 模型的工具链，输出 LDraw 源码、多视角、3D/VR 预览以及可进 Blender 的 GLB。
items.why_it_matters: 这是 Agent-native 3D 创作的有趣样本：不是生成一张 LEGO 风格图片，而是生成有结构、可继续编辑和渲染的模型资产。
items.evidence: The official repo documents text-to-LDraw generation, a 3D viewer/player, Meta Quest 3 VR and Blender-editable GLB export; Oct 3 community radar flagged it as an early organic signal.

extra.trend_signal: Fresh Show HN/community attention around an open-source LEGO AI generator and structured 3D output.

items.title: gohokiehlee/rapid-mlx
items.summary: Apple Silicon 本地 LLM inference server + Mac App，兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic API，重点优化 prompt cache、tool calling、并发 Agent 和 MLX 推理。
items.why_it_matters: 本地模型竞争正从“能不能跑”转向 Agent workload 的 TTFT、并发和工具调用可靠性。Rapid-MLX 直接把 Claude Code、Codex/Aider 类客户端作为兼容目标。
items.evidence: Official site reports about 3.5K GitHub stars and publishes reproducible benchmark conditions; claimed speedups versus Ollama are project-maintained benchmarks, not independent validation.

extra.trend_signal: Active Oct 3 development in the rapidly growing Apple-Silicon agent-inference niche.

items.title: ganeshmshetty/openclip
items.summary: macOS 上针对任意已选中文字弹出 contextual actions 的原生工具，可复制、转换、计算、AI 改写，并允许自定义扩展。
items.why_it_matters: 它把 AI/自动化能力放进系统级文字选择交互，而不是要求用户切到独立聊天窗口；这种轻量、可编程的 ambient utility 很适合高频桌面工作。
items.evidence: Oct 3 repository snapshot showed 592 stars and 629 commits, with active updates and a native Swift implementation.

extra.trend_signal: Actively updated Oct 3; compact macOS utility with a programmable action model rather than a standalone AI chat UI.

items.title: enkiruntime/enki
items.summary: 纯 Rust 的异构 GPU compute 平台，目标是把普通 Rust 函数在 CPU 执行或 JIT 编译到 Vulkan 1.3 GPU 上。
items.why_it_matters: 如果路线成熟，它提供了一种不依赖 CUDA 专有栈、也不要求 nightly Rust 的 GPU 编程实验路径；目前仍非常早期，更适合作为技术观察项目。
items.evidence: Show HN surfaced Enki on Oct 2/3 as a pure-Rust heterogeneous GPU compute platform with Vulkan 1.3 JIT compilation; the repository was still extremely early at launch.

extra.trend_signal: Fresh Show HN systems project; technically interesting but weak adoption signal so far.

items.title: Showoff
items.summary: 面向 App 发布视频、App Store 截图和设备 mockup 的编辑器，可通过 MCP 让 Claude 先生成第一版，再由人在同一编辑器继续调整。
items.why_it_matters: 它展示了 Agent-native creative app 的合理交互：Agent 不是一次性吐出不可编辑成品，而是在真实编辑器里构建项目，人类随时接管并继续修改。
items.evidence: Product Hunt's Oct 3 daily listing described Showoff as a collaborative launch-video/App Store asset editor with Claude MCP support and 3D device mockups.

extra.trend_signal: Fresh Product Hunt launch on Oct 3; notable for editable Agent-assisted creative workflow.

items.title: Epure
items.summary: 可自托管的开源 error tracker，目标是兼容官方 Sentry SDK，只需把 DSN 指向自己的服务器；部署核心是 Rust binary + PostgreSQL。
items.why_it_matters: 错误追踪是典型的重型 SaaS 基础设施。Epure 用极简两容器架构尝试覆盖 grouped issues、breadcrumbs、releases、alerts 和 webhooks，适合希望控制数据和运维复杂度的团队关注。
items.evidence: Product Hunt's Oct 3 listing described Epure as an open-source VPS error tracker compatible with official Sentry SDKs, using one Rust binary plus PostgreSQL 16 and no Redis/Kafka.

extra.trend_signal: Fresh Oct 3 launch; appealing minimalist self-hosted alternative in a traditionally heavy observability category.

items.title: codegraph-ai/CodeGraph
items.summary: 把代码库解析成函数、类、imports 和 call chains 的语义图，通过 MCP、VS Code 扩展和持久 memory 给 Coding Agent 提供结构化代码理解。
items.why_it_matters: Coding Agent 的主要浪费之一是每次重新 grep/read 探索仓库。预索引代码图可以把结构、调用链和变更影响作为一次查询返回，并通过 tool profiles 控制 MCP 工具面和上下文成本。
items.evidence: Oct 3 agent-tooling coverage highlighted code-graph approaches as a way to reduce repeated repository exploration; the official repo exposes 42 MCP tools and supports 38 languages.

extra.trend_signal: Part of the Oct 3 context-efficiency trend alongside output compression and tool-result distillation.

items.title: tw93/Mole
items.summary: 开源 macOS CLI 工具箱，用于清理缓存/日志/残留、卸载 App、分析磁盘、维护系统并监控状态；另有原生 Mac App。
items.why_it_matters: 在 Agent 项目密集的一天里，它代表一个成熟而直接有用的非 AI 工具：把 AppCleaner、磁盘分析和系统维护类能力合并到一个脚本化 CLI。
items.evidence: Oct 3 repository snapshot showed 69,116 stars and active updates; the CLI remains free/open-source while the native app is commercial.

extra.trend_signal: Large established macOS utility with fresh Oct 3 activity; useful counterweight to the day's AI-heavy trend set.
